description: Maintain the legacy v1 reply while adding a strict v2 order representation
scenario: A versioned response service; consumers of the old endpoint may not break.
requirements: POST /api/v1/orders accepts {reference,amountCents} and returns 201 with numeric amountCents and exact reference
GET /api/v1/orders/{reference} preserves legacy JSON keys reference and amountCents
Unknown reference returns 404 in either version
Reject negative amountCents, duplicate reference and unexpected request fields with 4xx
language: Java 21; Spring Boot 4; run with one HTTP server
